description: No-security-extension certificate abuse (ESC9) via a controlled user with a weak UPN mapping.

telemetry.detail: Certificate request logged on the CA.
PKINIT TGT request with the issued certificate.
Certificate with CT_FLAG_NO_SECURITY_EXTENSION plus an altered UPN is a recognised ESC9 pattern.

prerequisite_privilege: Control of a victim account + enroll on a no-security-extension template
abuse_primitive: Set the victim UPN to a target, enroll, authenticate as the target.
notes: Relies on the template's disabled security extension and weak certificate mapping.
